annotations.title: Seven Governors chart of a birth

description:
Computes the Chinese Seven Governors and Four Remainders chart from "date", "time" and "place": the life palace, and for the Sun, Moon, five planets, Luohou, Jidu, Yuebei and Ziqi the longitude in degrees, lodge, du and palace, plus home-palace and raised-to-hall dignities with page locators. Facts only: no reading or verdict.

DELEGATE THIS: lodges are unequal and carried by precession.

CITATION: required. See server instructions.

date.description: Birth date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, Dec 1926-2100. Example: "1990-06-15".

place.description: Town or city of birth with region or country. Example: "Chicago, Illinois, US".

time.description: Birth time HH:MM, local at the birthplace. Example: "08:30". Required.

name: compute_seven_governors_chart
